_comment: 露脸模式规则：① 每个角色一条不同的 face token（≥60 字，逐字节复用）；② 同一角色的所有镜头都照抄它；③ 不同角色的 token 不许雷同。改完跑：python3 production/face_cast.py check-prompts --project production/yangshuming
_casting_note: 三个角色都是符合年代的虚构匿名人物（AI 生成），不是任何真实人物的容貌还原——杨树明、办案刑警、法官一律不以其真实容貌出现；杨树明在情景重现里由 C1 虚构匿名角色扮演（提示词与片内标签都写明「非本人容貌」）；九名受害者全程只以背影、物件、空椅或聚合数字出现，不给可辨识面容、不写真实姓名；押解镜头一律背影。本片不走定妆照图生视频（免费档 image_url 队列拥堵），跨镜一致性靠面容 token + seed，最终由 face_cast 画面闸门和人眼复核按「同形象」口径签收。

characters.name: 三十八岁男子（杨树明 · 情景重现 · 虚构匿名角色，非本人容貌）
characters.face: an anonymous Chinese man of around thirty-eight with a plain unmemorable oval face, soft medium cheekbones and a slightly narrow jaw, calm level dark-brown eyes under straight thick eyebrows, a straight average nose, thin closed lips, short neat black hair with a simple side part, clean-shaven olive skin, visibly in his late thirties — not elderly, no deep wrinkles, no grey hair

characters.name: 五十五岁老刑警（阳泉矿区 · 虚构匿名角色）
characters.face: an anonymous Chinese police detective of around fifty-five with a broad square weathered face, deep nasolabial folds and heavy brow ridges, small deep-set tired dark eyes with pouches beneath, a wide flat nose, a firm wide mouth, short salt-and-pepper hair cropped close at the sides, olive skin lined by years outdoors, visibly a veteran officer in his mid-fifties — alert, not frail

characters.name: 六十岁法官（阳泉市中级人民法院 · 虚构匿名角色）
characters.face: an anonymous Chinese judge of around sixty with a full dignified face, rounded cheeks and a strong chin, calm deep-set dark eyes under sparse greying eyebrows, a short broad nose, a wide mouth with thin pressed lips, short grey-white hair neatly combed back, pale olive skin with soft age lines, visibly in his early sixties — grave and composed, not frail
